newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AECI places 17.5 mln shares at 23 rand/shr.
newsitem.headline: AECI places 17.5 mln shares at 23 rand/shr.

text.p: Chemical and industrial group AECI Ltd said on Wednesday that it had successfully completed a combined domestic and international placement of about 17.5 million shares in AECI at 23 rand a share.
The shares placed were formerly held by Afex Holdings (Pty) Ltd.
The company said in a statement that Goldman Sachs International and Cazenove & Co had acted as joint lead managers of the placing on behalf of the liquidator of Afex.
It said further details on the transaction would be released before the end of October.
The placement follows AECI's announcement last month that it would unbundle Afex Holdings (Pty) Ltd to realise its investment.
In terms of the scheme, 12 percent of AECI's share capital held by Afex would be placed domestically and internationally.

In the earlier statement the company said major shareholder Anglo American Industrial Corp Ltd (Amic) would retain its effective interest in AECI after the placement at 52.6 percent and would buy some 13 percent of the issued share capital from the liquidator at the placement price.
The net proceeds of the placement of the shares and the sale to Amic would be distributed to AECI as a liquidation dividend.
The remaining shares in AECI owned by Afex, representing 25 percent of issued share capital, would be distributed to Amic as a liquidation dividend.
Shortly after 1000 GMT, AECI shares were trading up 15 cents from open at 24 rand on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, up from an intraday low of 22.50. In a volume of about 337,000 shares.
